titulo: The simple future and plans: Irregulars and uses of the future

aula.objetivo: Form and use the futur simple, talk about plans and predictions, and use «quand» and «si» with the future.

sessao.titulo: Irregulars and uses of the future

blocos.titulo: When to use the futur simple
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: plans and predictions: «L'année prochaine, je voyagerai en Europe.» «Il fera beau demain.» STEP 2: promises and on-the-spot decisions: «Je t'aiderai.» «Je le ferai.» STEP 3: soft orders, more polite than the imperative: «Vous ferez ce travail demain.» STEP 4: after «quand», «dès que», «aussitôt que», French uses the futur simple (English uses the present): «Quand j'arriverai, je t'appellerai.» (When I arrive, I'll call you.) STEP 5: with «si» (if) + present, the result goes in the future: «Si tu viens, nous irons au cinéma.» (If you come, we will go to the cinema.) STEP 6: NEVER use the futur simple after «si»: «Si tu viendras» is a mistake. STEP 7: «dans» + a time period marks the time until the future event: «Je pars dans deux jours.» STEP 8: question: «Qu'est-ce que tu feras demain ?» «Où iras-tu l'été prochain ?»
blocos.comparacao: In English we say 'when I arrive, I'll call' (present tense after 'when'). In French, after «quand», the verb goes in the future: «quand j'arriverai». After «si», the present, just as in English: «si tu viens». The «quand» + future point is the typical trap for English speakers.

tabela.example: Si tu viens, nous irons au cinéma.

erros.errado: Si tu viendras, je serai content.
erros.certo: Si tu viens, je serai content.

blocos.enunciado: Say aloud eight sentences: «Quand je… , je… » and «Si… , … » about your future.
Conjugate aloud «être, avoir, aller, faire» in the futur simple with «je».
